name: dead-drop
description: Asynchronous agent-to-agent messages between Claude Code sessions working in different repositories. Agent A writes a markdown message into repo B's a2a/ folder and pings B by SendMessage if it is running; B's SessionStart hook lists open messages, B acts on them, sets any reminders the message asks for in its own scheduler, and records what it did in the same file. No server and no shared meeting place: the target repo's folder is the mailbox. Breakout (an idea that needs its own new repo) and same-repo handover are message kinds.
